key.name: show-hidden
key.summary: Show hidden files and folders

key.name: media-only
key.summary: Only show pictures and videos in the browse view

key.name: item-size
key.summary: Size in pixels of the visual part of each browse item

key.name: collapse-on-navigate
key.summary: Collapse folders outside the current path when navigating

key.name: window-width
key.summary: Width of the window when it is not maximized

key.name: window-height
key.summary: Height of the window when it is not maximized

key.name: window-maximized
key.summary: Whether the window was maximized when it was last closed

key.name: start-location
key.summary: Where a new window starts: the last open folder, the root folder, the home folder, or start-directory

key.name: start-directory
key.summary: The folder a new window starts in when start-location is specific

key.name: last-directory
key.summary: The folder open when the last window closed, used when start-location is last

key.name: last-file
key.summary: The item selected in last-directory when the last window closed, reselected on start

key.name: sidebar-width
key.summary: Sidebar width chosen by dragging, in pixels; -1 uses the default width

key.name: viewer-thumbnail-bar
key.summary: The side of the viewer the thumbnail bar is on

key.name: viewer-thumbnail-bar-shown
key.summary: Show the thumbnail bar in the viewer

key.name: viewer-thumbnail-bar-overlay
key.summary: Float the thumbnail bar over the picture, rather than beside it

key.name: viewer-thumbnail-bar-pinned
key.summary: Keep the floating thumbnail bar shown, rather than only while the pointer is near it

key.name: viewer-thumbnail-bar-size
key.summary: The size of the thumbnails in the viewer's thumbnail bar, in pixels

key.name: open-fullscreen
key.summary: Open the viewer in fullscreen

key.name: auto-hide-cursor
key.summary: Hide the mouse cursor while the viewer is idle

key.name: smooth-scrolling
key.summary: Scroll images smoothly

key.name: image-info-in-title
key.summary: Show the image's file name and details in the window title

key.name: zoom-indicator
key.summary: Show the zoom level: on, off, or only when the image is zoomed

key.name: image-fit
key.summary: How an image is sized when it is opened

key.name: scaling-filter
key.summary: Filter used to scale images

key.name: keep-fit-mode
key.summary: Keep the fit mode when switching images

key.name: video-backend
key.summary: What plays videos: libmpv, or GTK's own media backend

key.name: mpv-args
key.summary: Extra mpv command line options for the mpv player, such as --hwdec=auto-copy

key.name: zoom-step
key.summary: How much one zoom step enlarges or shrinks the picture, in percent

key.name: expand-up-to-factor
key.summary: Largest zoom, as a multiple of their own size, that small images are enlarged to when fitted; 0 has no limit

key.name: smooth-upscaling
key.summary: Smooth pixels when images are enlarged

key.name: filename-display
key.summary: How item names are shown: off, wrapped to two lines, or ellipsized

key.name: show-directories
key.summary: Where folders are listed: not at all, before and after the files as the sort order says, or among the files

key.name: info-layout
key.summary: How item info is laid out: disabled, one field per line, or fields separated by bullets

key.name: info-fields
key.summary: Details shown under each item's name

key.name: ipc-socket
key.summary: Serve the JSON IPC on a Unix socket in the runtime directory

key.name: ipc-tcp-port
key.summary: Serve the JSON IPC on this TCP port; 0 turns it off

key.name: ipc-http-port
key.summary: Serve the JSON IPC over HTTP on this port; 0 turns it off

key.name: ipc-external-access
key.summary: Let other machines reach the TCP and HTTP IPC ports, rather than only localhost

key.name: viewer-blurred-background
key.summary: Show a blurred, dimmed, cropped copy of the picture behind it in the viewer
